name: Philemon
bio: Philemon, a beloved fellow laborer of Paul whose house hosted a church, was the master of the slave Onesimus. Paul wrote to appeal to him, as a personal favor rather than a command, to receive back the runaway Onesimus (who had since become a believer) no longer as a slave but as a beloved brother, offering to repay any debt Onesimus owed and asking Philemon to prepare him a lodging, confident he would do even more than asked (the Epistle to Philemon).
